notes.title: Update 1.3.1.0 is available now. Performance, optimization, QoL, fixes!
notes.content:
Hey!

First, we'd like to thank you for supporting Gameboom VR! Our Cooking Simulator VR sells great, we've won the VR Game of the Year award on Steam, and now we can work on some new games for you. However, this does not mean that we are forgetting about our first game - Thief Simulator VR!

Thief Simulator VR receives another patch today, which introduces a number of improvements. The new version of the game is full of changes that improve both the performance of the game and its mechanics. Full changelog below:

Changes:
- The game is 1GB smaller
- Graphical optimization (materials, shaders, big textures)
- New functionality - you can use fast travel within one neighborhood, using the car
- It is easier to get in and start the car
- It is easier to hide in designated places (wardrobe, bed, dumpster)
- Limiting memory consumption for weaker RAM and VRAM (texture compression)
- Removal of information about too weak VRAM (textures compress automatically)
- NPC pathfinding calculations are lighter
- UI Change - Text display is less resource-intensive
- Better texture blending
- Additional info about remote grab in the tutorial
- Larger default remote grab distance
- In seated mode, the player's belt is higher
- More stable handling of quickslots on the belt
- By default, crouching is always lower than standing (seated mode)

Fixes:
- Some items were floating above the ground
- Duplicating items
- Some materials shined too much
- Removal of lag at the first breaking of the window
- Some objects were showing through the fog
- The mountains in the second neighborhood were disappearing
- The player's character does not jitter
- The tablet does not jitter while driving
- The paintings are not pixelated
- A typo in the Polish language version
- Some windows looked broken but were not
- Crowbar could not be raised
- 3 or 4 hands were rendered when the game couldn't determine if we were playing by Steam or Oculus

Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/dERxD78

Thanks for constant support and sharing your valuable feedback!

Best,
Gameboom VR Team

notes.title: Thief Simulator VR Full Game Out Now!
notes.content:
The day has come - Thief Simulator VR is leaving Early Access and becoming the full game.

We have thanked you several times already and we want to do it again. Developing Thief Simulator VR would not be so easy without the huge support of the community. Your advice and ideas on Discord have helped us a lot, making the game better and better over time. Even now, when we are working from home through a pandemic - we feel your support and the work goes smoothly.

Thus, since the game's debut in the form of Early Access:


 we've made 149 minor changes to the gameplay
 we added a significantly better tutorial
 we changed the look of the inventory
 we have introduced new story quests
 players got an additional neighborhood
 changeable weather appeared
 players got the opportunity to buy a house and decorate it

notes.title: Performance+ patch available on beta branch
notes.content:
Hey!

We've been a little quiet lately. We owe you a few words of explanation about what is happening in GameBoom VR.

We are currently still working on the Performance+ update that we announced. Why does it take so much time? It's because we carefully check every element of the game.

TL;DR
Thief Simulator VR requires very thorough code analysis. If you want to help - we invite you to beta testing. Details of the beta at the end.

Performance+:

What are we doing at GameBoom VR to make Thief and future games run better?

- We transform the map so that there is no place where your frame rate will drop. This requires repeatedly analyzing the map and adjusting the game for performance degradation.
- In addition, developers are redesigning AI to make it behave more naturally and without problems for CPU.
- We also deal with how objects in the game are displayed. Our new system [Universal Render Pipeline] makes the game offer more frames per second.
- We also decided to switch to the latest version of the Unity engine
-The previous light and shadow system has been replaced by a completely new solution. It is "friendlier" for VR technology.
-That's not all - developers are also rewriting the game code. In this way, we can be sure that everything will run smoothly, without "tiring" the computer.
- We also deal with shaders. In short, it's about the way the texture displays on the object. For example: if our "sun" shines orange, then what should the object in the game look like - brighter, more orange? We check, improve and optimize.
- Sometimes a strange situation may cause a decrease in performance - we collect data from you and check such situations. For this we force the game to "difficult conditions" to check what the game code does not cope with.

Beta-:

Now you can download the current version of the update, which should improve the performance of the game on your computers. How to download "beta-" files you will learn from this thread.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1019550/discussions/0/1740010344366175625/

Remember to download “beta-”!!!

What information do we need from you?

The ideal feedback is:
-screenshot with FPS number
Frame times from SteamVR (Click three horizontal lines in the SteamVR window -> Developer -> Advanced Frame Timing
-Processor
-Graphics Card
-RAM
-VR headset

also the general impressions about the new patch - even without the all above - are very welcome!

And here is the thread where you can give us your feedback and share your impressions:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1019550/discussions/0/3829691444565613687/

notes.title: Weekly News - Virtual thief in 2020
notes.content:
Hey!

2020. It sounds futuristic! This year we will have a lot of VR games that will probably steal many hours from our lives. What about Thief Simulator VR and GameBoom VR?

We returned to work after the Christmas break and we have a few tasks ahead of us. Here's what GameBoom VR intends in 2020:

1) Still gather information from you and create the game in such a way that everyone can have fun in it. During the Steam Winter Sale there were a lot of comments, for which we thank you very much! We read them all and write them down.
2) Release the full version of Thief Simulator VR! This year we will leave Early Access (by the way, we remind you that the price of the game will also increase, so maybe it's a good idea to buy it now?). We are currently finishing porting the game to a new engine, which should significantly improve the title's performance. The developers of the original version have already sent us the necessary files with remaining content to add, so we will also focus on this.
3) Our Discord server will receive small changes so as to become a place where we can exchange ideas for our games more efficiently. Yes, gameS. Join us! https://discord.gg/YuKhZ27
4) OK, I can't leave you with such uncertainty. What games? As you probably know, as soon as the developers of Prison Simulator finish the game, we will create a VR version. Btw. have you already added the title to your wishlist? https://store.steampowered.com/app/1088190/Prison_Simulator_VR/

But… Prison Simulator VR and Thief Simulator VR are not the only games we will be preparing. We can't reveal the details, but we have plans for two secret ports of other games that have gathered very large communities around them in a flat version. However, this will be the future you have to wait for.

So yes ... in 2019 our studio has grown significantly. At the beginning of the year, we had one room and now we have a much more comfortable office. And all these thanks to your trust in our game. We will repay you with more good games. 2020 and next years promises to be even better for us all.

See you next week!
GameBoom VR devs

notes.title: Vive Cosmos support, more physics and performance optimisations!
notes.content:
Hello there!

The new patch (v 1.1.3b) is finally here! There were many changes and additions made, let me start with the most prominent ones. We finally added official support for Vive Cosmos - so now, officially all headsets and controllers on the market are supported! We believe that we fixed the performance issues on Richie St. now - playing on both neighborhoods is enjoyable. Do you like Boneworks? If so, there is a good information for you - we added more hands collisions e.g., now you can close the door using open hand, in a more phycisal way. We also improved ‘easiness’ of the game e.g. now there is also a quick slot on your backpack for crowbar, so you won’t equip it by mistake when reaching for bigger items on the floor.
If the loading screen makes you sick - there is option to use default SteamVR look.
We also fixed important issue with game resolution - it wasn’t read correctly from settings after game restart / reload. Remember, that the game resolution can only be changed in the game, changes via SteamVR won’t be applied. 

Thank you for your valuable feedback and continuous support - it means a lot! Enjoy new patch :)

Here is the full change log:

New stuff:
- Vive Cosmos support!
- Quickslot on backpack (you can attach the crowbar to the backpack)!
- Hands collide with more obstacles (like wall, fence, etc., you can hit a door by your hand to close it), this can be turned off in options
- Performance optimization (especially on Richie St.)
- Possibility to switch off fade controllers
- Possibility to switch off highlights on items
- Possibility to disable hands on items (items do not mess up when picked up from heap of items)
- Add visual extension on belt and backpack where you can store the crowbar
- Possibility to change PC mouse speed (after clicking sprocket)
- Possibility to open dev console with ‘Q’ key
- New loading room
- Possibility to change loading room to SteamVR look (in options)
- Possibility to change more graphics settings


Changes:
- Smaller range of possible resolutions to set

- Marker on story item disappears after the item is collected
- Remove text “It’s place for my tools”
- Disable possibility to open inventory by grabbing backpack in the center
- Disable possibility to grab backpack with Grab Pinch
- Lock axis in Movement Direction Controller mode
- Brighter night vision
- Faster cutting window glass
- Better window colliders
- Controllers bindings path

Fixes:
- Fix resolution doesn’t automatically change after first start of the game
- Fix resolution doesn’t automatically set after game reloading
- Fix pressing Cancel button near construction area moves player inside construction area (rich neighborhood)
- Fix power switch

notes.title: New patch (v 1.1.1) is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello there,

with a little delay, but we are finally ready to push new patch to public.  In short: we fixed all urgent bugs, improved performance (~10% on GPU, on CPU - we removed big spikes during robbering and police chase) and made the game more forgiving in some aspects (it's easier to put smaller items in backpack and it's easier to carry the TV). Also we change quality settings, we admit that we overdid them - if you played above Very Low and want to keep the same quality - move one step higher e.g. if you played on Medium, set quality settings to High (more details in full change log).
As promised, we continue our work on improving game in all aspects according to your feedback (which is great and very helpful!). We are also moving to the new game engine which should be a big step in terms of performance!
Thanks for your great attitude and happy playing!

Here is the full change log:

Patch v1.1.1 (changes from v1.0.2):

Changes and new things:
- Better performance on GPU
- Quality Settings changed:
  Very low - the same
  Low - half texture size, the rest stays the same
  Medium - old Low
  High - old Medium
  Very High - Old High
- GPS map in a car
- People notice that you're using a flashlight on them
- You can open some stoves (but not all currently!)
- You can set fire on stoves (but not on all currently!)
- You can set fire on barbecues
- Interactable curtains (it's experimental, you can set it on in options)
- Grass performance (less grass diversity)
- Easier carrying old tv
- Finger on drill moves when you use it
- Tutorial: 'Hide your crowbar' changed to 'Put back your crowbar'
- Player is now teleported to the 'start' position after falling down through the map

Fixed:
- Walking and running is sometimes slower/faster
- Getting stuck near bath
- Items fall through backpack when trying to collect it
- A drill doesn't show up when disassembling the second car
- Gearbox and interceptor couldn't be taken off when disassembling a pickup
- Anti-burglar blinds for windows don't lock the window (only when they fall down because of the late hour)
- Cut window sets locked if the police were called when we grab the window
- Manget hand showing when the player keeps grabbing after the item was taken from his hand
- Fix NPC stacks (especially policeman)
- Cars have different wheels during disassembling (than on neighborhoods)
- Direction movement controller option, the controller that is responsible for walking now sets the direction of movement (previously controller responsible for rotation was doing this)
- Radio colliders in our house
- Gearstick moves too much
- Car box's text can be seen when you open inventory
- Windows at houses 113 and 108
- Disappearing candlestick in house 106
- Wrong scale of 'Jacket'
- Furniture colliders
- Doors' anchor points for lockpicks in houses 207 and 208
- Vines near house 208

notes.title: Thief Simulator VR Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Hello there!

The official trailer is here! Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=grul1fC-6jE;full][/previewyoutube]
Thief Simulator VR is a game developed by the Polish studio GameBoom VR. Our goal was to port the entire Thief Simulator game to virtual reality headsets. The result of the work is a big VR game, which is characterized by:

- fully-immersive realistic mechanics in VR. Feel how it is to lock pick doors, smash everything in a house, steal cars, jump through windows and hide in a trash
- follow a plot and pay off a debt to a mysterious family or choose by yourself which house you will rob next in this sandbox world
- disassembly stolen cars, hack phones and tablets in your hideout; and sell all goods in a pawn shop or by online
-  buy new thief tools and gadgets that will allow you to rob richer people
- drive cars with fully implemented VR-adapted driving model and play with a car interior

We plan to release the game in late October. We are still working on several patches and implementing solutions suggested on our Discord server. (https://discord.gg/q2sfNxE 😄 Join us!)

If you have any questions, I'll be happy to answer them on Steam forum or discord!

notes.title: First gameplay video (work in progress)
notes.content:
Hello there!

I would like to share with you our first gameplay video. Remember, that it’s still work in progress :)

https://youtu.be/hZOG006CaVA

As for now, we have implemented three types of locomotion:
- arm swinging (mostly for running outside)
- head bob (for sneaking in a house, especially when holding microwave oven)
- touchpad (if you don’t want to engage to much ;p)

But it’s up to you which and when you’ll use.

And as you see in the video, you can also grab all stuff and throw. And generally interact with all objects in the game.

What’s your first impression guys? What do you expect from this game?
Share your thoughts and ideas in discussion:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1019550/discussions/0/1812044473314085617/

Many more features and videos to come! Stay tuned!
